label: June 1–7, 2026
intro: Rainy season is here — mornings are your window before afternoon thunderstorms.

activities.title: Curtain Up Studios “Playful Performers”
activities.why: Structured creative drama sessions — kids explore, create, and play. Thor would love the hands-on imaginative play, and it's a nice chance to meet other kids.

activities.title: HEI Schools Music Club: “Little Stars Theatre” — Space Theme
activities.why: Space-themed stories, movement, and music. Thor the drummer will enjoy the music + movement combo. Worth asking if single sessions are available.

activities.title: Level Up Basketball Weekend Academy
activities.why: 5-year-olds may be a touch young for the full program, but worth checking if they accept younger kids — an energetic, active afternoon if so.

activities.title: Grow Learning Gardens — Forest School Club
activities.why: Outdoor gardening and forest school at one of Bangkok's best parks. Perfect for a curious 5-year-old who likes building with natural materials.

activities.title: Chatuchak Weekend Market
activities.why: The toys and craft stalls are great for Thor; the plant section is surprisingly fun for little ones too. Not far via expressway.

activities.title: Taling Chan Floating Market
activities.why: Right in your neighborhood. Food, boats, and a very chill vibe for a lazy morning with Thor.

activities.title: Benjakitti & Lumpini Parks
activities.why: Both great for cycling — Thor can bring his bike. Benjakitti has a dedicated kids' cycling loop.

activities.title: Children's Discovery Museum
activities.why: Hands-on exhibits, always solid. Good for a hot midday escape.
